candidate.name: intraday_range_amount_profile_alignment_js_240m
candidate.mechanism: Jensen-Shannon similarity between the full fixed-clock intrabar log-range participation distribution and transaction-amount participation distribution
candidate.formula: For 240 selected bars set r_i=ln(high_i/low_i), p_i=r_i/sum(r), q_i=amount_i/sum(amount), m_i=(p_i+q_i)/2, and return 1-[0.5*sum p_i ln(p_i/m_i)+0.5*sum q_i ln(q_i/m_i)]/ln(2), with zero contributions equal to zero.
candidate.zero_rule: Exact zero range and amount remain valid zero masses. Require positive finite total range and amount; use no pseudocount, smoothing, threshold, or dropped bar.
candidate.fixed_grid: Exactly 240 bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00; exclude the required raw 09:30 row.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_range_share_volume_confirmation_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both relate same-bar intrabar range to trading activity
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign018 computes a signed Pearson association between log range levels and log1p share-volume levels. Campaign087 compares nonnegative full-session participation distributions using bounded Jensen-Shannon similarity, reads amount rather than share volume, and has no signed covariance.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_price_discovery_alignment_js_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both use amount participation and the same fixed Jensen-Shannon similarity family
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign053 aligns destination-bar amount with absolute adjacent close returns over 238 within-half transitions. Campaign087 reads no close or return, retains all 240 bars, and aligns amount to contemporaneous own-bar high-low range mass. Holding high/low fixed while changing closes changes Campaign053 but not Campaign087.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_range_amount_peak_timing_alignment_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both use the same 240 high-low range and amount fields
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign082 retains only the distance between two last-maximum indices. Campaign087 uses every mass at every clock position; profiles with identical maxima and peak times can have arbitrarily different Campaign087 values.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_participation_entropy_240m and intraday_intrabar_range_participation_entropy_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: each univariate factor sees one of Campaign087's two marginal distributions
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Separate entropies do not encode clockwise co-location. Jointly permuting only one profile preserves both entropies but generally changes Campaign087.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_center_of_mass_240m, intraday_amount_profile_serial_persistence_240m, intraday_amount_clock_dispersion_240m, intraday_amount_local_peak_density_238p, intraday_amount_path_efficiency_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Those are univariate clock, sequence, peak, dispersion, or path-shape summaries. Campaign087 is a bivariate co-location score and is invariant to no learned amount transformation.
